# M5 (object model) exit criterion, part 1: the object-model cases of HavokOS
# pike/tests/run_tests.pike's case table -- every case of the table the M3
# (m3_selection.txt) and M4 (m4_selection.txt) selections left out:
# inheritance as objects, destruct (vital objects included), environments,
# privs, call_outs, livings and this_player(), get_garbage(), origin() and
# call_stack().
#
# --- loading, inheritance and destruct
inherit loads the parent object
inherits efun
inherits deep levels and rebuilt chain
inherits survives destructed blueprints
deep_inherit_list is a copy
function_exists
destruct
reload recompiles source
code runs on after self-destruct
master survives destruct
sefun survives update
# --- the call stack
call_stack frames
origin(): local only for calls from the same object
# --- environments, efun defaults, privs, call_outs
move and environment
efun defaults when omitted
efun undefined arg is not omitted
# --- garbage
get_garbage
get_garbage skips virtual objects
# --- this_player()
this_player destructed mid-command
create() enable_commands keeps this_player
